# RC34 — local document outline fallback

Date: 2026-07-28

## Scope

- Upgraded `Esc g s` from server-only document symbols into a Document Symbols picker with a bounded local fallback.
- When the active file has a ready synchronized language server, `Esc g s` still requests semantic document symbols and accepts flat or hierarchical LSP results.
- When no ready server exists, `Esc g s` builds a local outline for common source files and Markdown headings using the built-in lexical language detection.
- The local fallback inspects at most 20,000 lines and retains at most 4,096 outline rows.
- Selecting either semantic or local symbols jumps the cursor and records the origin in jump history.

## Proof boundary

This is host-side automated and package evidence only. It does not prove real iPad Magic Keyboard key delivery, Blink/mosh/tmux routing, OSC 52 clipboard behavior, touch/trackpad feel, reconnect behavior, or a real language server. Run `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md` on the target hardware route before treating this as hardware-approved.
